notes.text: The tanks sit at Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County, at the south end of the base.
Once inside a Rhino, keep killing enemies with it until the trophy unlocks.
It is a hidden Bronze worth 10G.

versions.text: Steal a tank from the air base and kill enemies with it.
Survive and win a fight against military vehicles.
The exact trigger has not been confirmed.

differs.call: Follow the steal-a-tank route; the two detailed guides agree on it.

notes.text: The Snap Gun comes from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 and opens the store's locked back door.
Kicking the back door in trips the alarm, so pick the lock instead.
A note in the back room holds the safe code; Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is the store both guides use.
It is a Bronze, and the whole robbery has to stay undetected.

notes.text: Big bank vaults stay locked until the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.
There are 8 vaults; 5 earn the trophy, but 100% completion wants all 8.
Every vault job brings a 4-star wanted level, and Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000.
It is one of the Silver trophies, worth 40G.

notes.text: Robbing a large bank vault also counts, so it tends to pop during the Chapter 4 vault mission.
To get it sooner, block in an armored truck and stick a sticky bomb on its rear doors.
Escape means leaving the red search zone or reaching a Pay 'n' Spray.

versions.text: Any armored truck, and a large bank vault job counts too.
An armored truck robbed on the motorway, then losing the police.

differs.call: No location limit; the vault job is the easy route.

notes.text: The goal is a fully revealed Leonida map with no fog left anywhere.
Flying over the dark patches, ideally in a plane, is the quickest way to clear them.
Every listing agrees the task is to explore the whole of Leonida; GTABase rates it 20G.

The 100% checklist goes further and wants all 39 operations.

notes.text: Order an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it while standing by the bar.
It is a hidden Bronze worth 5G.

versions.text: Gives exact steps: the Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar.
Still lists the exact trigger as unconfirmed.

notes.text: The Key Cloner from Chapter 3 is needed before you can take the car.
The trophy wants you to crash a car out through a showroom window.
It is a hidden Bronze worth 5G.

versions.text: Only the blue Banshee in the southern Vice City showroom counts.
No specific car named; exact steps unconfirmed.

differs.call: Use the blue Banshee to be safe.

notes.text: The bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation first marked in Chapter 2.
Take all three valuables: the watch in the southeast office, the shotgun on the northeast table and the hallway safe (bring sticky bombs).
The trophy pops after you shake the police, and missed items can be taken on a later visit.

notes.text: Both Jason and Lucia must reach the top of the Strength stat.
Training at a fitness club with your partner along raises both characters together.
Gym training opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break; home workouts are possible after the story.

versions.text: Max Strength for both leads.
Team up with popular people.
Trigger not confirmed.

differs.call: Max Strength for both; three guides agree.

notes.text: You need 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile; most players get there just by playing.
Running over civilians or police speeds the count up.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings > UI to watch progress, and avoid sliding into the permanent Irredeemable profile.

versions.text: 500 Criminal Profile actions in open play.
Big decisions made in story missions.

differs.call: It is the 500-action count; no story choice needed.

notes.text: After Chapter 3's Credit Check, go back alone as Lucia to the Little Cuba Payday Loans and rob it again.
Flee on foot; a getaway car does not count.
It is a hidden Bronze whose text hints at a second attempt.

versions.text: Exact steps given: second Payday Loans robbery as Lucia, escape on foot.
Method still listed as unconfirmed.

notes.text: It is a UFO Easter egg on the road northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2 AM, with no partner along.
The event may not appear every night; drive the abducted woman back to her car.
Other guides only call it a strange event or Easter egg.

versions.text: A free-roam night-time UFO event.
Tied to a story moment.

differs.call: Free roam, per the detailed PowerPyx steps.

Busy spots like Vice City streets or Ocean Beach make it quick.
It is a melee hit from a moving vehicle, worth 5G as a hidden Bronze.

versions.text: 10 bike kicks in 60 seconds, anywhere.
A melee drive-by linked to bowling.
Exact steps unconfirmed.

The $250,000 is a running total across fence visits, and Yasmani pays the best rate.
Marked bills come from banks and Payday Loans; it is a visible Bronze worth 20G.

notes.text: Eight garages are for sale, costing roughly $160,000 combined.
They are bought in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which opens after Chapter 2's Daily Driver.
The four garages handed out by the story are not part of it.
Leaving it for late game spares early cash.

notes.text: Moses hands over the Scooter Bros app in his Chapter 2 mission; register 10 vehicles through it.
Each registration costs money and needs a free garage slot.
At first only tracker-free cars are accepted; from Chapter 3 a Pay 'n' Spray handles tracked ones.
